data.title: San Cun Renjian
data.synopsis:
In a different world with strong spiritual energy, Wang Baole, a warm and cheerful little fat man, saw through the illusion created by the teachers in the entrance examination of the famous school "Dragon Taoist Academy", and won high scores with his excellent performance, and obtained the "Magic Department". The quota of specially recruited students has since overcame obstacles and opened up his own way of upgrading. In the process of cultivating immortals and fighting monsters, he made a large number of close friends, and thus started a series of hilarious adventure stories.

(Source: bilibili)

data.title: Chong Chu Diqiu
data.synopsis:
When the earth becomes a secret room, can you escape from it? 

In the future world where the universe is highly civilized and interstellar navigation is free, a meteor shower destroyed half of the earth. In the name of protecting the earth, the high-level force Galaxy Eye launched the "Sky Wall Project". Unexpectedly, once the sky wall rises, it can never be opened again. And this is just the tip of the iceberg, and a bigger disaster is still brewing. The young Mai Dang firmly believes that no matter how terrible the predicament is, there is hope only if you rush out!

(Source: Youtube, translated)

data.title: Jiaonang Jihua
data.synopsis:
The "Capsules Project" invites professional teams from various industries with mature animation production experience to create short films ranging from 5 to 15 minutes, themed around "Extreme Emotions." Teams will choose two of seven emotion capsules—"Thorn," "Desire," "Joy," "Illusion," "Numbness," "Tears," and "Passion"—and, based on their effects, create a collection of high-quality animated short films in different formats and styles. Through diverse forms and styles, the project aims to convey a variety of emotional stories and, together with Chinese animators, propel them onto the world stage.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

data.title: Shan Hai Juelun
data.synopsis:
The emperor of the Central Plains has been missing for several months. Li Mao, a general of the Imperial Guard, and Wei Xian, a court advisor, are secretly dispatched by the Empress Dowager to search for the emperor. Along the way, they encounter Zong Sheng, a martial arts prodigy who turns into a child when he cries; Fan Tian, ​​a teenager with partial amnesia; and Gong Liangzhen, a kind and resilient young Taoist nun suffering from a leg ailment. Their initial encounter is fraught with conflict, yet each harbors their own agenda. The source of all this chaos seems to point to a legendary, mysterious immortal mountain and the secret of eternal life…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
